page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Running head at top, with page number at top right. Signature at the foot left and catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: [?]gone honor amissus Servato-ris, quot toties alapas pertu-lerit, conspui se passus fit, & mille affici contumeliis? Ni-mis certe, nimis lubrico loco posita esset viri boni fama & existumatio, adeoque male cum illo ageretur, si a cujusvis hominis arbitrio dependeret, & ad nutum pessimorum di-minueretur. Ut maximæ sit dementiæ vereri, ne per injurias nobis illatas honor aufera-tur, aut per alterius diffama-tionem infamemur. Quid quod nullibi in jure inter modos, quibus alicui infamia ir-rogatur, injuriandi modus, quo pessimi male loquuntur melioribus, referatur. Etenim nonnisi lege, vel edicto, vel sen-tentiâ judicis, vel genere pœnæ infamem quem fieri posse observamus. Ut si quis alios hic nobis modos fabricet, sine lege, sine ratione loquatur, ad-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "gone" at the start (possibly a fragment carried over from the previous page, marked [?]). The line "Servato-ris" and similar hyphens are printed hyphens at line ends. The word "sine" appears as "fine" in the scan at the line "fine lege, fine ratione"; the long s is printed here as plain s, so the reading is uncertain. The catchword "eo-" is at the right foot. The faint marks at the lower right edge are a digitiser's watermark and are left out.
